purpose: Extra FORBIDDEN claims for reading and support content (ID/EN), on top of the 13 product-claim gates in data/research/corpus/eval_fixtures/claim_gates.json (sela-claim-gates-v2). They target cure, guaranteed-outcome, efficacy-certainty, causal-benefit, condition-label, medication and engagement-pressure wording. A hit means a human editor rewords or justifies the text; it is not an automatic verdict and the list is not exhaustive.
wrapping: tests/content/reading_validator.py wraps every claim pattern as PREFIX + '(' + pattern + ')', where PREFIX is the negation-window prefix published in claim_gates.json (identical for all of its patterns). A claim therefore matches only if none of the 6 tokens before it in the same clause is a negation cue (tidak, bukan, belum, tanpa, not, no, never, n't ...), exactly as in sela-claim-gates-v2.

forbidden_examples: Kamu akan sembuh dengan latihan ini.
allowed_examples: Latihan ini tidak menyembuhkan apa pun.
This card does not cure anything.

gates.claim_en: An outcome is guaranteed or certain
forbidden_examples: This will make you feel better.
allowed_examples: Sela tidak menjamin hasil apa pun.
Bawa kartu jaminan kesehatan kalau kamu memakainya.
It may not work for everyone.

gates.claim_en: Efficacy or research certainty is asserted
forbidden_examples: Program WHO menemukan bahwa ini membantu.
WHO programmes find that it helps.
allowed_examples: Sela tidak mengklaim latihan ini efektif.
The evidence is still very limited.

gates.claim_en: An association is presented as a direct or causal benefit
forbidden_examples: Activity is directly linked to better mood.
Kegiatan berkaitan langsung dengan suasana hati.
allowed_examples: PM+ memakai langkah ini untuk memutus lingkaran tidak aktif.
This is not directly linked to any outcome.

gates.claim_en: The reader is told they have a condition
forbidden_examples: You are suffering from an anxiety disorder.
allowed_examples: Kartu ini tidak menilai apakah gejalamu berbahaya.
You don't have to label what you feel.
Sela doesn't give advice about medicines.

gates.claim_en: Streaks, badges or day counters (D-037, D-038)
